violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: Chlorine based sanitizer observed less than 50ppm.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. CHEF ADDED MORE OF PACKET TO SINK.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: in the 3 door undercounter fridge crayfish (8/7), and chicken wings (8/8)
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. FOODS DISCARDED.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: oysters
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PIC CERT EXPIRED YESTERDAY.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at the bar handwashing sink used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surface of the ice chute and enclosed components of the soda guns (holders- CDI) are not being cleaned as required.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold holding equipment: refrigerated prep unit and 3 door undercounter fridge
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: EHS observed what appeared to be pest droppings on cloths near the cooking equipment.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: sides of the 3 door undercounter fridge, interior and exterior of the popcorn machine.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Fats (Inspection Date: 02/25/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The faucet at the bar sink is leaking when turned off.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the flooring throughout the bar area is in need of cleaning as well as plumbing.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that a few light bulbs are missing in the light fixtures as well as light shield and holes in areas of the physical facility throughout kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Label Marked, Last Date Served/Sold Info
violations.observation: The date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served is not recorded on the tag or label. Tags from mussels and clams that the facility receives fresh are not being dated.
violations.corrective_action: The identity of the source of shellstock (oysters, clams, mussels) that are sold or served shall be maintained by retaining shellstock tags or labels and marking the tag or label with the date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served. EHS INFORMED CFM OF THE REQUIREMENT.

violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. DISCARDED.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Insect Control Devices, Installation
violations.observation: EHS observed fly paper above the 3 compartment sink in the kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: Relocate the insect control device so that it is not located over a food preparation area and dead insects are prevented from being falling on exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. PIC agreed to move fly paper so it was not above a food prep surface.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: EHS observed in use utensils being stored between the backsplash of. The three compartment sink and the wall of the kitchen..
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC removed in use utensils from being stored in between wall and three compartment sink agreed to store them in a dry clean place.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: EHS observed the ice machine and bottom of the refrigerators in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. PIC agreed to clean ice machine and bottom of fridges by next inspection. Fats (Inspection Date: 02/24/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: EHS observed holes in the ceiling in the kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PIC agreed to have holes in ceiling of kitchen repaired by next inspection.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: EHS observed floor behind the bar area, walls in the kitchen, ceiling in the bar area, and floors in the kitchen area under the grill and three compartment sink in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. PIC agreed to clean facility by next inspection.
